text:
[Council File 26-0005-S199; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 6112 West Romaine Street (Case No. 895141), Assessor I.D. No. 5534-026-003, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated November 6, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the property at 6112 West Romaine Street (Case No. 895141), Assessor I.D. No. 5534-026-003, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Housing Department request to take 6112 West Romaine Street out of the Rent Escrow Account Program.
